international.title: Fiona the hippo dies after ingesting knitted hat at Cincinnati zoo
international.summary: Zoo staff tried a colonoscopy, vibration plate and other procedures to aid the hippo in passing the hat to no avail Fiona the hippo, one of America’s most famous zoo animals, has died after efforts to remove a knitted hat that she swallowed after it fell into her enclosure proved unsuccessful. “It is with extreme sadness that we share with you the devastating news that Fiona did not make it after multiple attempts from our amazing vets and keeper team to help her through what ended up being a medical emergency,” the zoo wrote in a post on social media .
